distractors.reason: 'Make the origin' is not used. 'Make' creates things; 'trace' means to follow back to a source.
'Take the origin' is not standard. 'Take' is used with action, not with tracing a history.
'Do the origin' is not a collocation. 'Do' pairs with tasks.

example_sentence: Linguists ___ the origin of the word back to Latin.
l1_interference: Русскоговорящие могут сказать 'make the origin' по аналогии с 'создать происхождение'; в английском 'trace the origin' — проследить.
explanation: 'Trace the origin' means to follow a word, custom or idea back to its earliest known source. It is the standard verb in etymology.

related_collocations.example: The word has an Old English root.
The term was borrowed from French.
The word derives from a Greek verb.

memory_tip: TRACE THE ORIGIN = follow a word back to its source | MAKE / TAKE / DO are not used
